feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 June 2026 5:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 16 June 2026 at 5:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic and high pressure over continental Europe as weak fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly south or southwest 4 or 5 in central to western areas, but mainly south or southeast 2 to 4 in eastern areas, becoming southwest 4 or 5 in all waters tonight. Then decreasing 3 or 4 for a time tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at times, with areas of mist and fog patches, clearing to become mainly fair during the morning tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, but mainly 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area, increasing 5 or 6 in the west of the area Thursday morning, and in all waters Thursday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate Thursday afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain developing overnight into Thursday, becoming patchier in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain arriving later.
